# pve_node_shutdown (Action)

Shut a node down (POST /status with command=shutdown).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_node_shutdown" "example" {
  config {
    command = "reboot"
    node    = "pve1"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_node_shutdown.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Specify the command. (default: shutdown) One of: `reboot`, `shutdown`.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
